Body.Content:
Since introducing pay-per-GB pricing for Azure DevOps Artifacts, customers have requested a set of views to further understand how to take action on their stored and billed artifacts.  

Currently, you are only able to view your total storage at a high level for your entire organization. With this feature work for Artifacts storage exploration, you will be able to drill-down one level further to the project level for feeds and symbols. This will help you identify the projects and areas that require optimization and further investigation. 

Read the Azure DevOps blog for the latest updates.
